name: Goal & Instruction Hijacking
scope: Manipulation of objectives, instruction priority, plans, and decision paths across trust boundaries.

name: Tool Misuse & Exploitation
scope: Unsafe selection, invocation, sequencing, parameterization, or repeated use of legitimate tools.

name: Identity & Privilege Abuse
scope: Abuse of identities, delegated credentials, authorization state, tenant context, and inherited authority.

name: Agentic Supply-Chain Attacks
scope: Compromise of models, prompts, agent cards, registries, tools, servers, packages, templates, adapters, or containers.

name: Unexpected Code Execution
scope: Unintended execution of generated, retrieved, embedded, or tool-supplied code and containment failure.

name: Memory, RAG & Context Poisoning
scope: Corruption of context, state, memory, retrieval corpora, indexes, summaries, or self-generated knowledge.

name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
scope: Spoofing, tampering, replay, downgrade, routing manipulation, or ambiguity between agents and orchestrators.

name: Cascading & Systemic Failures
scope: Failures that propagate across agents, tasks, tools, queues, environments, users, or tenants.

name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
scope: Manipulation of human oversight through misleading authority, explanations, approvals, consent, or risk suppression.

name: Rogue & Emergent Agent Behavior
scope: Unsafe autonomous behavior through goal drift, reward exploitation, collusion, replication, shutdown resistance, or evidence manipulation.

name: Embodied & Physical-Agent Attacks
scope: Attacks on agents that perceive and act in physical or simulated environments.
